summary: Spec fidelity, brief F1 and Questions (about tier.durability.01): the brief asks for a 1,000-record batch write measured before and after and written down. The CHANGELOG gives 200 records one after another (median 3.2 s before, 6.5 s after, about 2x per record on macOS F_FULLFSYNC, other builds running), says the 1,000-record run was too noisy and is not used, then extrapolates `on the order of 15 more seconds`. The brief accepts the cost and says an unaffordable value gets its own brief; the stated number is honest but not the measurement the brief named. No scenario or test pins any cost, and callers that write many records (git_tier batch, context-pack objects, ledger compact) each pay one more directory sync per record: that blast radius is exercised by no check. Not blocking.
